faqs.q: What is Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)?
faqs.a: CRO is the process of improving your website design, copywriting, and layout to increase the percentage of site visitors who complete a target action (like buying or submitting a form).

faqs.q: How does GA4 server-side tagging help my business?
faqs.a: Server-side tagging routes data directly to GA4 through your custom subdomain, preventing data loss from browser ad-blockers and improving page speeds.

faqs.q: Do you need a lot of traffic to run A/B tests?
faqs.a: For statistically significant A/B tests, we recommend at least 3,000 monthly visitors. For lower traffic sites, we run user behavior diagnostics and heuristic usability audits.
